notes.subject: 2026 outreach reply — not adding this entertainment this year
notes.body: On Aug. 27, 2026, Jeni Heerdt replied to Desiree's outreach for the Sept. 19-20 Durango Autumn Arts Festival: 'We aren't looking to add this type of entertainment to the festival this year, but I appreciate you checking in.' Desiree replied the same morning thanking her for the response and asking her to keep The Adventure Zone in mind if anything changes. Treat this as a 2026 decline, not a permanent do-not-contact or permanent lack-of-fit decision, because the response was explicitly limited to this year. Current reply contact: Jenifer (Jeni) Heerdt, jeni@durangoarts.org. Source: Adventure Zone Gmail, Aug. 27, 2026.

followUps.label: 2027 Durango Autumn Arts Festival follow-up
followUps.reason: Jeni declined this type of entertainment for 2026 specifically, without ruling out future years. Recheck the 2027 festival early enough to approach before plans are set.
